items.prompt: What is the opposite of hot?
hints: Opposites are as different as can be.
Think of ice. How does ice feel?
Find the word that means not hot at all.
items.explanation: Cold is the opposite of hot. Ice is cold and the sun is hot.

options.why: Warm is a little bit hot. Look for the word that means not hot at all.
The sun is hot. Sun is a thing, so it cannot be the opposite of hot.

hints: Fruit is something you can eat.
Fruit grows on trees and plants.
Which one could you eat as a snack?
items.explanation: A mango is a fruit. It grows on a tree.

options.why: A chair is something you sit on.
A shoe goes on your foot.

hints: Opposites mean very different things.
Do the easy ones first.
Start with up. Which word means the other way?
items.explanation: Big and small, up and down, open and shut, happy and sad are opposites.

items.prompt: Sort the words. Animals or food?
hints: Animals are alive and can move.
Food is something we eat.
Start with cow. Is it an animal or food?
items.explanation: Cow, duck and frog are animals. Rice, bread and banana are food.

hints: Three words go together.
Think: which ones are animals?
Find the one that is not alive.
items.explanation: Cat, dog and hen are animals. A bus is not an animal.

options.why: Cat is an animal, like dog and hen.
Dog is an animal, like cat and hen.
Hen is an animal, like cat and dog.

items.prompt: Choose the opposite. 'The opposite of day is ___.'
hints: Think about when you sleep.
Opposites are very different.
When is it dark outside?
items.explanation: Night is the opposite of day. Day is light and night is dark.

options.why: We see the sun in the day.
Morning is part of the day.

hints: Think of a cat going in a box.
Now the cat comes the other way.
The word has three letters and starts with o.
items.explanation: Out is the opposite of in.

hints: Three answers are right.
Think about getting dressed.
Which things go on your head or your feet?
items.explanation: You can wear a hat, a sock and a shoe. You eat with a spoon and read a book.

options.why: You eat with a spoon.
You read a book.

items.prompt: These pictures are all about the ___.

figure.alt: Four pictures: the sun, a cloud, rain and wind.

hints: Look at all four pictures.
You can see them all when you look at the sky.
What word do we use for sun, rain and wind together?
items.explanation: Sun, cloud, rain and wind are all weather words.

options.why: Body words are like hand and nose.
School words are like pencil and desk.

items.prompt: Choose the opposite. 'The box is full. The bag is ___.'
hints: Look at the word full.
Find the word that means nothing inside.
Try each word: The bag is ___.
items.explanation: Empty is the opposite of full. An empty bag has nothing in it.

options.why: Big is about size.
A full bag can be heavy. Look for the opposite of full.

items.prompt: Sort the words: body, family or school.
hints: Body words are parts of you.
Family words are people at home.
Start with nose. Where is your nose?
items.explanation: Nose and knee are body words. Sister and grandma are family words. Ruler and desk are school words.

hints: Opposites mean very different things.
Three pairs mean the same thing.
Read each pair. Do the words mean the same or different?
items.explanation: Fast and slow are opposites. The other pairs mean the same.

options.why: Big and large mean the same.
Little and small mean the same.
Happy and glad mean the same.

hints: Think of a towel after a bath.
Clothes hang in the sun until they are not wet.
The word has three letters and ends with y.
items.explanation: Dry is the opposite of wet.

items.prompt: What is the opposite of the opposite of up?
hints: Do it in two steps.
First, find the opposite of up.
Then find the opposite of that word.
items.explanation: The opposite of up is down. The opposite of down is up again.

options.why: Down is the opposite of up. Now find its opposite.
Under is about being below something.
Over is a different word. Think in two steps.
